bucket.description: Sampling interval between points, such as "5m" or "1h".

endTsSec.description: Last point timestamp in seconds since epoch (UTC).

points.description: Number of aligned points in each returned series.

series.description: Balance series ordered by asset ID, then account bucket.

balance.description: Exact chart balances as decimal strings in whole units of the asset with up to 18 decimal places, for example '1250.5'. Values align 1:1 with implicit timestamps.

startTsSec.description: First point timestamp in seconds since epoch (UTC).

balances.description: One entry for every supported unified asset, including assets with zero balances. Sorted by available trading amount (highest first), then by asset symbol alphabetically.

available.description: Amount currently available for new trading activity, as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '1250.25'. This value already accounts for active reservations.

funding.description: Funding balance as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '1250.5'.

fundingRevision.description: Opaque monotonic revision for the funding value. Higher means newer; zero means no funding state has been observed. Trading values have no revision: their position is (trading_epoch, trading_sequence).

reserved.description: Reserved amount in the trading bucket as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '0.25'.

trading.description: Trading balance as a decimal string in whole units of the asset, for example '1250.5'.

tradingAppliedThroughTsNs.description: Every Trading transfer of the account whose tsNs is at or below this value, in Unix nanoseconds as a decimal string, is applied in these balances: a receipt within tradingEpoch.

tradingEpoch.description: Trading numbering the Trading values are in, an unsigned 64-bit integer as a decimal string. It changes when the numbering restarts: then reload. Compare it only for equality. '0' with tradingSequence '0' when the account has no Trading balances yet.

tradingSequence.description: Trading sequence the Trading values are at within tradingEpoch, as a decimal string. Apply the balance stream's Trading updates from tradingSequence + 1 on.

btcPrices.description: BTC-USDT close prices as decimal strings in USDT, one per timestamp, for example '61000.25'. Enables client-side conversion to BTC denomination without refetch.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.EXTERNAL_ADDRESS: External wallet or chain address. The address is lifecycle-derived and may be empty until ledger-to-lifecycle correlation is projected.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.FEE_ACCOUNT: Fee ledger side, for example spot or perp trading fees.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.PRIVATE_COUNTERPARTY: Private off-chain counterparty that must not be identified to the caller. account_id and address are intentionally omitted.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.SYSTEM_ACCOUNT: System, operator, clearing, or other non-user side.

x-poly-enum-descriptions.deposit: External deposit into a funding account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.fee_refill: Funds transferred from the fee treasury's trading account to replenish fee funds.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.fee_sweep: Collected fees transferred to the fee treasury's trading account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.funding_opening_balance: Opening balance of a funding account: the balance it held on Polyester Chain when the account's transfer history starts, credited from a system account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.internal_batch: One leg of an all-or-nothing batch of internal transfers between Trading accounts: credited together with the batch's other legs. Legs of one batch share its batch reference.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.maker_fee: Maker fee charged for a trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_affiliate_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to an affiliate in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_broker_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to a broker in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.quickswap_polyester_fee: QuickSwap fee paid to Polyester in the received asset.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.system_adjustment: Balance adjustment with a system account, including account seeding credits or corrections. May credit or debit the user's account; the transfer direction identifies which.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.taker_fee: Taker fee charged for a trade.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_fee_leg: Fee paid to a fee recipient when a trading withdrawal completes.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_request_fee: Debit of a withdrawal from the Trading account that Zipper rejected or that failed to execute: the whole amount sent to Zipper for it, the request fee included. The withdrawal's other fees are not charged. A rejected withdrawal refunds that amount, less the request fee, to the user's own wallet; one that failed to execute is not refunded, and Zipper settles it with the user outside Polyester Chain. A withdrawal from the Funding account uses withdraw_failed instead.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.trading_withdraw_reserve: Reserve leg for a trading withdrawal.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.withdraw: External withdrawal from a funding account.
x-poly-enum-descriptions.withdraw_failed: Debit of a withdrawal from the Funding account that Zipper rejected or that failed to execute: the whole amount that left the account for it. A rejected withdrawal refunds that amount, less the request fee, to the user's own wallet; one that failed to execute is not refunded, and Zipper settles it with the user outside Polyester Chain. A withdrawal from the Trading account uses trading_withdraw_request_fee instead.

ApiKeyIdAuth.description: ID of the API key that signs the request. An API-key request sends it with X-API-TIMESTAMP and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyIdAuth.name: X-API-KEY-ID

ApiKeySignatureAuth.description: Ed25519 signature of the request, made with the API key's private key and encoded as hex or base64. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-TIMESTAMP.
ApiKeySignatureAuth.name: X-API-SIGNATURE

ApiKeyTimestampAuth.description: Time the request was signed, in Unix milliseconds. An API-key request sends it with X-API-KEY-ID and X-API-SIGNATURE.
ApiKeyTimestampAuth.name: X-API-TIMESTAMP

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.description:
Public trading API for market makers and integrators.
Connect RPC over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with JSON and Protobuf.
info.title: Polyester API

get.description: Retrieve the latest balances for an account. Supports optional subaccount scoping and returns asset symbols with decimal amounts. The answer reflects every balance update published before the call began, and its Trading values are one atomic cut at the position it returns (tradingEpoch, tradingSequence); when it cannot answer so yet, the call answers 503 and can be retried with a short backoff. Each call costs 1 unit of the trading_read rate-limit class.
